info.prompt: Close-up of a rogue's gloved hand hovering over dice, the fingertips crackling with stolen charge pips. The dice themselves are translucent ice-stone with veins of electric magenta, suspended in a lattice of neural gold filigree. Behind them, the battle royale's closing circle contracts—six outer tiles scorching black at the edges, their collapse progress bar draining from green to red as amber emergency glyphs pulse across the hacker-terminal overlay at screen bottom.
